thread:
nina: quick heads-up — starting a focused spike on pruning old API surface for the v3->v4 migration. main thing: remove legacy 'x-client-mode' toggles and replace with server-side compat fallback that can be toggled per-tenant. want to sketch rollout plan and flag names. 

matt: +1. what's the fallback behaviour? serve legacy field mapping or rewrite payloads? 

nina: fallback = rewrite + lightweight adaptor layer. goal is zero-downtime: new clients talk to native v4 handler; old clients routed to adaptor. adaptor preserves old response keys and error shapes. 

ada: we should avoid an eternal adaptor. what's the sunset signal? 

nina: plan: opt-in compat window for tenants for 90 days, telemetry-driven extension if errors > 0.5% on critical routes. docs and migration guide required. 

rebecca: telemetry: propose metrics: compat_adaptor_invocations, compat_errors, compat_rewrite_latency. add tag tenant_id, model, route. 

kevin: how do we detect clients? header sniffing is flaky. prefer capability handshake during auth. fallback to header only if handshake absent. 

nina: agreed. handshake looks like: `X-Client-Capabilities: v4` during token exchange. we'll add authv2 validator. 

matt: rollout steps? staging -> opt-in on dedicated -> global dark-launch -> enable by default after 90d? 

nina: roughly: (1) add adaptor + tests, (2) dark-launch on 5% of production traffic with feature flag `compat_adaptor/darklaunch`, (3) enable opt-in tenant flag `tenant_flags:compat:v4_adaptor` for self-serve, (4) monitor metrics and rollback on error spike. 

ada: tests — need contract tests that assert parity on critical fields. add a prompt-suite in evals repo and routable e2e. 

nina: yep — will add evals job and make CI gate fail if parity drift > 0.2%. also add a small synthetic traffic generator to exercise edge cases (chunked streaming, early cancels). 

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: canary group tomorrow 09:00 UTC if green tests. /deploy compat-adaptor canary 

nina: assign owners: nina (API), matt (runtime adaptor), ada (telemetry/evals), rebecca (observability dashboards), kevin (auth). i'll write RFC doc and PRs. any blockers? 

matt: one ask — make the adaptor opt-out flagtable for dedicated customers; some need longer windows. 

nina: noted. will add tenant-level TTL and manual opt-out. 

rebecca: will prototype dashboard panels and error alert: alert if compat_errors rate > 0.5% over 5m with severity paged. 

nina: awesome. i'll post RFC link when drafted. thanks all :thumbsup:
